result.brief: 首篇系统综述视频生成模型的后训练与对齐，提出隐式/显式对齐统一框架，归纳监督微调、自训练蒸馏、偏好奖励与推理时四类方法，并梳理数据集、评测与开放挑战。
result.reason: Survey of post-training and alignment for video generation models, covering fine-tuning, distillation, reward-based and inference-time methods, plus benchmarks and long-horizon temporal consistency.
